verdict.rationale: Adyen Agentic documents tokenizing shopper payment credentials and passing ACP/UCP tokens to merchants. That is a related but different capability: nothing in the evidence shows a user-funded wallet that the agent holds and spends from, user-set spending controls, or balance visibility. Wallet provisioning is a fair question for an agentic-payments product, so the axis applies and the verdict is none, not na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can provision a wallet my agent holds and spends from — funded and controlled by me, with balance visibility
